title: Application is hereby made by Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of a change in the jFuel Charge to be filled to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the months of June, July and August, 1989. The fuel charge reflects costs of fuel contained in charges for power purchased by the Company. Application is also made for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 800. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
